name: Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner
paste:
DAVCO TILE & GROUT CLEANER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner, August 2022, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-tile-groutcleaner.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner is a specially formulated to clean tough dirt and stains from tiles and grout. Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner can be used to remove minor Efflorscence.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner is suitable for most common tiled surfaces.
    - Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner can remove minor Efflorescence from grout surfaces.
    - Removes tough dirt and stains from tiles and aged grout and helps remove mould and mildew from grout surfaces.
    Suitable for most types of tiles including; ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, quarry and slate tiles
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Specially formulated ingredients
    - Effectively cleans tiles and grout
    - Removes minor efflorescence from grout
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: Clear liquid
    - Bulk Density: 1.0 kg/L
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1 Litre Jerry can
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture if unopened
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions off ground out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Mixing.
    - Add Tile & Grout Cleaner to a clean plastic bucket and dilute with water at a ratio of 10 parts water to 1 part Tile & Grout Cleaner (5L of water to 500ml Tile & Grout Cleaner).
4.3 Application. 1. Always use a saturated mop or sponge to wet down the surface with clean water before applying product 1. For normal cleaning, dampen a mop or sponge with the solution and wipe over the surface before rinsing immediately with clean warm water. 2. . For heavily soiled areas apply a greater quantity of the solution. Allow the affected area to soak for up to 10 minutes and then scrub with a stiff nylon brush before rinsing well with clean warm water.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first - 1. Place 2-3 drops on the tile. 2. Wait 15 minutes. 3. Rinse well and examine when dry to determine if the product is suitable for use.
    - Avoid prolonged contact and always rinse the area with clean, warm water
    - All tools and containers should be plastic. Do not use with metal
    - Avoid splashing or spilling on surrounding areas
    - Do not use on polished marble, limestone or metallic glazed tiles. Always conduct a test patch before use to determine product suitability
    - Do not use with any other detergents or cleaning materials
    - For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first - 1. Place 2-3 drops on the tile. 2. Wait 15 minutes. 3. Rinse well and examine when dry to determine if the product is suitable for use.
    - Do not use on polished marble, limestone or metallic glazed tiles. Always conduct a test patch before use to determine product suitability
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner, August 2022, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-tile-groutcleaner.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Davco Tile and Grout Cleaner, version 12/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/Davco%20Tile%20and%20Grout%20Cleaner.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
